sceneConcept: An unobtrusive thirty-year-old Chinese chip-inspection engineer stands alone against a transparent background. He wears rimless glasses and a neatly tucked pale-blue dress shirt with carefully rolled sleeves. Looking down with restrained concentration, he holds a single tiny unmarked neural-interface chip in fine tweezers for final inspection, under soft even frontal light without a screen, code, sinister laboratory imagery or supernatural effects. Visual refresh: a precision inspection ocular implant paired with a clean short technical jacket.
